displayedInputs.question: The radius of \(\odot O\) is \(4\). Points \(A,B,C,D,E,F\) divide the circumference into six equal parts. Find the length of chord \(AB\).
Which statement is correct?

choices.A: Equal central angles subtend equal arcs.
choices.B: In the same circle, equal arcs subtend unequal chords.
choices.C: In the same circle, equal arcs subtend equal central angles.

choices.A: An inscribed angle equals the central angle subtending the same arc.
choices.B: All inscribed angles subtending the same chord are equal.
choices.C: Inscribed angles subtending the same arc or equal arcs are equal.
